name: mom-monorepo
description: MOM 모노레포: backend(FastAPI :8000) + frontend(React :3000) 를 npm run dev 한 번으로 같이 띄운다

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:api && npm run setup:web
scripts.setup:api: cd backend && python -m venv .venv && cd .. && node scripts/py.mjs -m pip install -r requirements.txt
